                scope:character = {
                    is_female = yes

                    exists = owner
                    owner ?= {
                        NOT = { has_technology_researched = bolt_action_rifles }
                    }
                    OR = {
                        has_role_of_type = general
                        has_role_of_type = admiral
                        AND = {
                            is_interest_group_type = ig_armed_forces
                            has_role_of_type = politician
                            OR = {  # A monarch shouldn't wear this, but a republican ruler can
                                AND = {
                                    is_ruler_of_own_country = no
                                    home_country ?= {
                                        has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_monarchy
                                    }
                                }
                                AND = {
                                    is_ruler_of_own_country = yes
                                    home_country ?= {
                                        NOT = { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_monarchy }
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        AND = {
                            has_role_of_type = agitator
                            is_interest_group_type = ig_armed_forces
                        }
                    }
                    owner ?= {
                        NOT = { has_technology_researched = bolt_action_rifles }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

            modifier = {
                add = 30000
                scope:pop ?= {
                    home_country ?= {
                        has_technology_researched = automatic_machine_guns
                    }
                }
                has_dlc_feature = ip3_cosmetics
                austrian_empire_clothes_pop_trigger = yes
                OR = {
                    officers_clothes_pop_trigger = yes
                    soldier_clothes_pop_trigger = yes
                }
                OR = {  # November to February
                    month < 3
                    month > 10
                }
            }
        }
    }

            }

             }
            accessory = {
                mode = add

                template = all_epaulettes
                range = { 0 0 } # For the randomness to work correctly
            }
        }
        weight = {
            base = 0
            modifier = {
                add = 15000
                has_dlc_feature = ip3_cosmetics
                scope:character ?= {
                    is_adult = yes
                    OR = {
                        culture ?= { cu:hungarian ?= this }
                        home_country ?= { c:HUN ?= this }
                        home_country ?= {
                            c:CRO ?= this
                            exists = c:HUN # Intentional
                            NOT = {
                                has_variable = triune_kingdom_var
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    NOT = {
                        home_country ?= {
                            exists = c:AUS
                            is_subject_of = c:AUS
                            is_diplomatic_play_enemy_of = c:AUS
                        }
                    }
                }
                austrian_empire_clothes_trigger = yes
                OR = {
                    military_clothes_trigger = yes
                    monarchy_clothes_trigger = yes
                    AND = {
                        armed_forces_clothes_trigger = yes
                        OR = {
                            politician_clothes_trigger = yes
                            ruler_clothes_trigger = yes
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

    christian_character_clothes = {
        dna_modifiers = {
            accessory = {
                mode = add
                gene = outfits
                template = christian_outfits
                range = { 0 0 }
            }
        }
        weight = {
            base = 0
            modifier = {
                add = 5000
                military_clothes_trigger = no
                scope:character ?= {
                    NOT = { has_template = FRA_francois-rene_de_chateaubriand }
                    # largely intended for Protestant and Catholic nations, but formulating it this way gives wiggle room to catch some edge cases
                    religion = {
                        has_discrimination_trait = heritage_christian
                        NOR = {
                            rel:orthodox = this
                            rel:oriental_orthodox = this
                        }
                    }
                    OR = {
                        AND = {
                            OR = {
                                has_role_of_type = politician
                                has_role_of_type = agitator
                            }
                            is_ruler_of_own_country = no
                            is_heir_of_own_country = no
                            OR = {
                                has_ideology = ideology:ideology_theocrat
                                is_interest_group_type = ig_devout
                            }
                        }
                        AND = {
                            is_ruler_of_own_country = yes
                            owner = {
                                NOT = { c:PAP ?= this }
                                has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_theocracy
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

                                nordic_clothes_pop_trigger = yes
                            }

                                month = 5 # June. The trigger for months is on a 0-11 scale.

                    AND = {
                        native_american_clothes_pop_trigger = yes
                        AND = {
                            scope:pop ?= {
                                NOT = { culture = cu:inuit }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                scope:pop ?= {
                    NAND = {
                        religion = rel:catholic

                    }
                }
            }
        }

                        european_clothes_trigger = yes
                        african_diaspora_clothes_trigger = yes
                    }
                    ruler_clothes_trigger = yes
                    republic_clothes_trigger = yes
                }
            }
        }
    }

                accessory = male_belt_generic_01
            }
        }

        weight = {
            base = 0
            modifier = {
                add = 90000

                has_dlc_feature = ep1_cosmetics

                scope:character ?= {
                    is_ruler_of_own_country = yes
                    is_historical = no

                    is_adult = yes

                    owner ?= {
                        is_in_power_bloc = yes
                        OR = {
                            is_power_bloc_leader = no
                            is_subject = yes
                        }
                        power_bloc ?= {
                            has_identity = identity:identity_sovereign_empire
                        }
                        country_rank <= rank_value:minor_power
                    }

                monarchy_clothes_trigger = yes
                OR = {
                    european_clothes_trigger = yes

                            culture = cu:malagasy

    power_bloc_necklace_sovereign_empire = {
        dna_modifiers = {
            accessory = {
               mode = add
               gene = necklaces
               template = necklace_power_bloc
               range = { 0 0.2 }
            }
        }

        weight = {
            base = 0
            modifier = {
                add = 90000

                has_dlc_feature = ep1_cosmetics

                scope:character ?= {
                    is_ruler_of_own_country = yes

                    is_adult = yes

                    owner ?= {
                        is_in_power_bloc = yes
                        is_power_bloc_leader = no
                        power_bloc ?= {
                            has_identity = identity:identity_sovereign_empire
                        }
                    }
                }
                OR = {
                    AND = {
                        arabic_clothes_trigger = yes
                        # necklace doesn't work with keffiyeh headwear
                        scope:character ?= {
                            NOT = {
                                religion = {
                                    has_discrimination_trait = heritage_islamic
                                }
                                culture = {
                                    OR = {
                                        cu:bedouin = this
                                        cu:mashriqi = this
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    chinese_imperial_clothes_trigger = yes
                    indian_clothes_trigger = yes
                    japanese_clothes_trigger = yes
                    native_american_clothes_trigger = yes
                    siamese_clothes_trigger = yes
                    AND = {
                        african_clothes_trigger = yes
                        scope:character ?= {
                            NOT = { culture = { has_discrimination_trait = heritage_abyssinian } }
                        }
                    }
                    scope:character ?= {
                        is_interest_group_type = ig_landowners
                        owner ?={
                            NOT = { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_monarchy }
                        }
                        culture = {
                            has_discrimination_trait_group = language_group_iranic
                        }
                    }
                    scope:character ?= {
                        culture = {
                            has_discrimination_trait_group = language_group_iranic
                        }
                    }
                }
                NOR = {
                    scope:character ?= {
                        is_ruler_of_own_country = yes
                        is_female = no
                        owner ?= {
                            c:MUG ?= this
                            has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_monarchy
                        }
                    }
                    scope:character ?= {
                        is_ruler_of_own_country = yes
                        is_female = no
                        owner ?= {
                            c:PER ?= this
                            has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_monarchy
                        }
                        culture = {
                            has_discrimination_trait_group = language_group_iranic
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

                        is_female = no
                        owner ?= {
                            c:PER ?= this
                            has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_monarchy
                        }
                        culture = {
                            has_discrimination_trait_group = language_group_iranic
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

                    is_adult = yes

                    OR = {
                        AND = {
                            is_historical = no
                            has_trait = erudite

                        AND = {
                            is_historical = no
                            has_trait = literary
                        }
                        AND = {
                            is_historical = no
                            has_trait = master_bureaucrat
                        }
                        AND = {
                            is_historical = no
                            has_trait = engineer
                        }
                        AND = {
                            has_dlc_feature = ep1_cosmetics
                            OR = {
                                has_trait = erudite
                                has_trait = literary
                                has_trait = master_bureaucrat
                                has_trait = engineer
                            }
                            is_ruler_of_own_country = yes

                                    OR = {
                                        has_principle = principle:principle_advanced_research_1

                                        has_principle = principle:principle_advanced_research_3
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }

                }
            }
        }
    }

    military_power_bloc_cuirass = {
        dna_modifiers = {
            accessory = {
               mode = add
               gene = top_layer
               template = cuirass_top_layer
               range = { 0 1 }
            }
        }
        dna_modifiers = {
            accessory = {
               mode = add
               gene = sashes
               template = cuirass_sashes
               range = { 0 1 }
            }
        }
        dna_modifiers = {
            accessory = {
               mode = add
               gene = belts
               template = cuirass_belt
               range = { 0 1 }
            }
        }

        weight = {
            base = 0
            modifier = {
                add = 90000

                has_dlc_feature = ep1_cosmetics

                scope:character ?= {
                    is_ruler_of_own_country = yes
                    OR = {
                        european_clothes_trigger = yes
                        AND = {
                            exists = scope:character
                            scope:character = {
                                OR = {
                                    culture = cu:cherokee
                                    culture = cu:muskogean
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        african_diaspora_clothes_trigger = yes
                    }
                    OR = {
                        armed_forces_clothes_trigger = yes
                        military_clothes_trigger = yes
                        monarchy_clothes_trigger = yes
                        army_traits_trigger = yes
                    }
                    is_adult = yes

                    owner ?= {
                        is_in_power_bloc = yes
                        power_bloc ?= {
                            has_identity = identity:identity_military_treaty_organization
                        }
                    }

                    NOR = {
                        ### the Cuirass does not work with agitator_blanqui coat ###
                        has_template = fra_blanqui_character_template
                        has_template = agitator_alexandru_bogdan_pitesti
                        has_template = agitator_francesc_pi_i_margall
                        has_template = agitator_john_stuart_mill
                        has_variable = is_stirner_var
                        has_template = rus_leon_trotsky_character_template
                        has_template = canonic_count_dracula
                        has_template = exile_count_dracula
                        AND = {
                            has_template = fra_napoleon_iii_character_template
                            monarchy_clothes_trigger = no
                        }

                        has_template = usa_john_brown_character_template

                        has_template = fra_maurras_character_template

                        has_template = PER_reza_pahlavi
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
